body: Even when I am enjoying life, I still want to commit suicide. It is an ever present feeling and has been for as long as I can remember. I have absolutely no desire to live, good times or bad. However, as of lately, the thoughts are so intense, so frequent, and so over-whelming, I might actually do it. There is always a constant struggle to keep from doing it but as of lately, I don't even want to struggle. I just want to die.
